description: This file defines an abstract PHP class 'codeTrackerInterface' for interfacing with code tracking systems within the TestLink project. It includes methods for configuration parsing, database connection management, URL generation, and tracking interface properties.

classes.name: codeTrackerInterface
classes.description: Abstract base class for connecting and interacting with code tracking systems, meant to be extended for specific implementations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the interface with type, configuration, and name; attempts to connect if configuration is valid.

methods.name: setCfg
methods.description: Sets the configuration from an XML string, loading it into a SimpleXMLElement.

methods.name: getMyInterface
methods.description: Returns the PHP code for the specific interface implementation.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes database connection to the code tracking system based on configuration.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the interface is currently connected to the code tracking system.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Closes the database connection if active.

methods.name: buildViewCodeLink
methods.description: Generates an HTML link to view code in the tracking system.

methods.name: getEnterCodeURL
methods.description: Returns the URL for entering or creating code links.

methods.name: buildViewCodeURL
methods.description: Builds a URL to view specific code in the repository, with optional branch or commit parameters.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented in subclasses, providing template configuration.

methods.name: checkEnv
methods.description: Checks environment readiness for interface operation.
